justification:
# DR-UI-05: the connect handle ring is white in dark mode (board-free)

No board fixture can show this difference: the connect handles are selection overlay drawn on the
interaction layer, not anything a board stores or draws. Any board shows it in dark mode: select a
shape, and each connect handle on its selection rectangle is a white ring with a black dot on TS,
a solid black disc on C++ (ConnectHandleWidget.cpp:69-84: the ring is filled with
system_background_color, black in dark mode, the same colour as its stroke and the dot).

lekhjs test/interaction/connect-handle-dark-uf2.test.ts checks both themes on the TS side.

Owner request 2026-10-23 (Work 01M4X7TCHFB862XGT68GPY071C, round UF2).
